title: Jutta Leerdam to skip speedskating season due to personal reasons
summary: Olympic speedskating champion Jutta Leerdam has announced she will not compete this season. The Dutch athlete cited personal reasons for her decision. Leerdam is a prominent figure in the sport, having won silver at the 2022 Beijing Olympics in the 1000m event and gold at the 2024 World Championships.
summary_points: Olympic speedskating champion Jutta Leerdam will not race this season.
Leerdam stated personal reasons for her withdrawal.
She is the reigning 1000m world champion.
Leerdam won a silver medal at the 2022 Beijing Olympics.
